Maria (eng-platform): quick q — should the console rely only on JSON/YAML schema validation for routing configs or do we add a semantic linter? hit a case where header-match precedence and 'shadowing' can't be expressed by schema alone
Tanner (eng-ui): which case?
Maria (eng-platform): two routes same path, route A match header x-tenant: prod, route B match header x-tenant: prod and x-env: beta. if someone reorders or copies route blocks the intention changes. JSON Schema can't say 'no duplicate header matches across siblings'
Samir (eng-runtime): yup. schema handles shape & types but not cross-route constraints or ordering semantics. we need extra checks: duplicate header keys, overlapping match sets, and explicit precedence rules.
Tanner (eng-ui): UX question — do we show blocking errors on save, or inline non-blocking warnings? I vote inline warnings + optional quick-fix. block on deploy to prod only.
Maria (eng-platform): proposed flow: 1) keep schema (fast feedback) 2) run custom linter on save and in CI 3) editor: show linter as non-blocking warnings in draft, but block prod deploys + highlight exact range for fix. thoughts?
ui-qa (QA): make sure the error tooltip is keyboard accessible and copyable. Also include an anchor so we can link to the problematic line in bug reports.
linter-bot: routing-lint v0.4.2 failed on save: duplicate-header-match: route[2] header 'x-tenant' shadows route[0] — severity: warning
Maria (eng-platform): example YAML I ran into:

```yaml
- route:
    path: /api/v1/items
    match:
      headers:
        x-tenant: prod
    upstream: items-prod
- route:
    path: /api/v1/items
    match:
      headers:
        x-tenant: prod
        x-env: beta
    upstream: items-beta
```

Samir (eng-runtime): that exact snippet is ambiguous at runtime if we treat first-match-wins. linter should detect redundant/contained header sets and either warn or suggest merging. JSON Schema can't express subset relationships.
Tanner (eng-ui): for quick-fix could we offer a button: "collapse to explicit precedence" that adds an explicit priority field or reorders blocks and shows diff?
Maria (eng-platform): yeah — quick-fix options: (a) reorder so specific match first, (b) add explicit priority: 100/90, (c) merge into single route with more specific match. show diffs in editor.
Samir (eng-runtime): implementation notes: we can implement as node package that parses YAML -> AST, runs rules, returns LSP diagnostics. This gives editor integrations for VS Code & Console editor. Also reuse same linter in CI.
Maria (eng-platform): sample linter rule (pseudo):

```js
// rule: duplicate-header-match
function run(ast) {
  const routes = collectRoutes(ast);
  for (let i=0;i<routes.length;i++) {
    for (let j=i+1;j<routes.length;j++) {
      if (samePath(routes[i], routes[j]) && headersSubset(routes[j], routes[i])) {
        reportWarning(j, `route ${j} header set is subset of route ${i} — may be shadowed`);
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Samir (eng-runtime): tests should cover: header subsets, overlapping wildcards, header regex vs exact, and explicit priority field. add fixture harness.
Maria (eng-platform): CI plan: add routing-lint job in monorepo -> fail build for prod branch, warn for main/dev. console save: call lint endpoint, show warnings inline.
Tanner (eng-ui): I'll sketch UI patterns: inline gutter icon, hover tooltip, "apply fix" button that opens diff modal. Keep it non-modal for small fixes.
ui-qa (QA): add e2e for keyboard-only triage of lint panel + copy error text.
Maria (eng-platform): I'll open PR with linter integration + tests; @Tanner can you prototype quick-fix modal? tagging for review. :point_up:
Tanner (eng-ui): on it. :thumbsup:
linter-bot: noted — created issue #412 routing-lint: add duplicate-header-match rule and CI job
Maria (eng-platform): thanks — we'll iterate. short followups in this thread or drop design mocks in #eng-ui-design.
